 "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/aws"
 "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/athena"
 at "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/athena/types"
 "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/ecr"
 et "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/ecr/types"
 "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/glue"
 gt "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/glue/types"
 "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3"
 st "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3/types"
 "github.com/aws/smithy-go"
)

const data = "alpha,2\nbeta,3\nalpha,11\n"
const sql = "SELECT label, sum(amount) AS total, CAST(sum(amount) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS precise, sum(amount) > 5 AS significant FROM numbers GROUP BY label ORDER BY label"
var ctx context.Context
var sc *s3.Client
var ec *ecr.Client
var gc *glue.Client
var ac *athena.Client
var bucket, repository, database, workgroup, statePath string
var saved map[string]string

func emit(kind string, value any) { if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"kind":kind,"value":value}); err != nil { panic(err) } }
func must(err error) { if err != nil { panic(err) } }
func require(ok bool, msg string) { if !ok { panic(msg) } }
func s(p *string) string { return aws.ToString(p) }
func hash(b []byte) string { h := sha256.Sum256(b); return hex.EncodeToString(h[:]) }

type transport struct { host string; base http.RoundTripper }
func (t transport) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
 if r.URL.Scheme != "http" || r.URL.Host != t.host { return nil, fmt.Errorf("non-owned endpoint blocked: %s", r.URL) }
 var body []byte
 if r.Body != nil { var err error; body, err = io.ReadAll(r.Body); if err != nil { return nil, err }; r.Body.Close(); r.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(body)) }
 out, err := t.base.RoundTrip(r)
 evidence := map[string]any{"method":r.Method,"url":r.URL.String(),"target":r.Header.Get("X-Amz-Target"),"content_type":r.Header.Get("Content-Type"),"user_agent":r.Header.Get("User-Agent"),"request_body":string(body)}
 if err != nil { evidence["error"] = err.Error(); emit("wire", evidence); return nil, err }
 b, err := io.ReadAll(out.Body); out.Body.Close(); out.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(b))
 evidence["status"] = out.StatusCode; evidence["response_body"] = string(b); emit("wire", evidence)
 if err != nil { return nil, err }; return out, nil
}

func retain() {
 b, err := json.Marshal(saved); must(err); must(os.WriteFile(statePath,b,0600))
}
func seed() {
 _, err := sc.CreateBucket(ctx,&s3.CreateBucketInput{Bucket:&bucket}); must(err)
 put, err := sc.PutObject(ctx,&s3.PutObjectInput{Bucket:&bucket,Key:aws.String("data/part.csv"),Body:strings.NewReader(data),ContentType:aws.String("text/csv")}); must(err)
 repo, err := ec.CreateRepository(ctx,&ecr.CreateRepositoryInput{RepositoryName:&repository,ImageTagMutability:et.ImageTagMutabilityImmutable,ImageScanningConfiguration:&et.ImageScanningConfiguration{ScanOnPush:false},Tags:[]et.Tag{{Key:aws.String("proof"),Value:aws.String("schema205-to-212")}}}); must(err)

 emit("seed",map[string]any{"bucket":bucket,"repository":repo.Repository,"s3_etag":put.ETag,"data":data,"sha256":hash([]byte(data))})
 legacy()
}
func legacy() {
 obj, err := sc.GetObject(ctx,&s3.GetObjectInput{Bucket:&bucket,Key:aws.String("data/part.csv")}); must(err)
 b, err := io.ReadAll(obj.Body); obj.Body.Close(); must(err)
 require(string(b)==data,"legacy S3 bytes changed"); require(s(obj.ETag)==saved["s3_etag"],"legacy S3 ETag changed"); require(s(obj.ContentType)=="text/csv","legacy content type changed")
 repos, err := ec.DescribeRepositories(ctx,&ecr.DescribeRepositoriesInput{RepositoryNames:[]string{repository}}); must(err)

 repo := repos.Repositories[0]

 tags, err := ec.ListTagsForResource(ctx,&ecr.ListTagsForResourceInput{ResourceArn:repo.RepositoryArn}); must(err)

 emit("legacy_retained",map[string]any{"repository":repo,"tags":tags.Tags,"body":string(b),"etag":obj.ETag,"content_type":obj.ContentType,"sha256":hash(b)})
}
func catalog() {
 db, err := gc.GetDatabase(ctx,&glue.GetDatabaseInput{Name:&database}); must(err)
 require(db.Database!=nil && s(db.Database.Name)==database && db.Database.CreateTime!=nil && s(db.Database.Description)=="retained schema205 SDK proof","Glue database decode mismatch")
 table, err := gc.GetTable(ctx,&glue.GetTableInput{DatabaseName:&database,Name:aws.String("numbers")}); must(err)
 require(table.Table!=nil && s(table.Table.Name)=="numbers" && s(table.Table.DatabaseName)==database && table.Table.CreateTime!=nil,"Glue table decode mismatch")
 sd := table.Table.StorageDescriptor
 require(sd!=nil && s(sd.Location)=="s3://"+bucket+"/data/" && len(sd.Columns)==2 && s(sd.Columns[0].Name)=="label" && s(sd.Columns[0].Type)=="string" && s(sd.Columns[1].Name)=="amount" && s(sd.Columns[1].Type)=="bigint","Glue storage descriptor mismatch")
 require(sd.SerdeInfo!=nil && sd.SerdeInfo.Parameters["field.delim"]==",","Glue SerDe decode mismatch")
 wg, err := ac.GetWorkGroup(ctx,&athena.GetWorkGroupInput{WorkGroup:&workgroup}); must(err)
 require(wg.WorkGroup!=nil && s(wg.WorkGroup.Name)==workgroup && wg.WorkGroup.State==at.WorkGroupStateEnabled && wg.WorkGroup.CreationTime!=nil,"Athena workgroup decode mismatch")
 require(wg.WorkGroup.Configuration!=nil && aws.ToBool(wg.WorkGroup.Configuration.EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration) && s(wg.WorkGroup.Configuration.ResultConfiguration.OutputLocation)=="s3://"+bucket+"/results/","Athena configuration decode mismatch")
 emit("decoded_catalog",map[string]any{"database":db.Database,"table":table.Table,"workgroup":wg.WorkGroup})
}
func modeledErrors() {

 var api smithy.APIError; require(errors.As(err,&api) && api.ErrorCode()=="EntityNotFoundException" && api.ErrorMessage()!="","Glue Smithy error decode mismatch")
 emit("modeled_error",map[string]any{"service":"glue","concrete_type":fmt.Sprintf("%T",ge),"code":api.ErrorCode(),"message":api.ErrorMessage(),"fault":fmt.Sprint(api.ErrorFault())})
 _, err = ac.GetWorkGroup(ctx,&athena.GetWorkGroupInput{WorkGroup:aws.String(workgroup+"-missing")})

 api=nil; require(errors.As(err,&api) && api.ErrorCode()=="InvalidRequestException" && api.ErrorMessage()!="","Athena Smithy error decode mismatch")
 emit("modeled_error",map[string]any{"service":"athena","concrete_type":fmt.Sprintf("%T",ae),"code":api.ErrorCode(),"message":api.ErrorMessage(),"fault":fmt.Sprint(api.ErrorFault())})

func execute() {
 legacy()
 _, err := gc.CreateDatabase(ctx,&glue.CreateDatabaseInput{DatabaseInput:&gt.DatabaseInput{Name:&database,Description:aws.String("retained schema205 SDK proof")}}); must(err)
 _, err = gc.CreateTable(ctx,&glue.CreateTableInput{DatabaseName:&database,TableInput:&gt.TableInput{Name:aws.String("numbers"),TableType:aws.String("EXTERNAL_TABLE"),Parameters:map[string]string{"classification":"csv"},StorageDescriptor:&gt.StorageDescriptor{Columns:[]gt.Column{{Name:aws.String("label"),Type:aws.String("string")},{Name:aws.String("amount"),Type:aws.String("bigint")}},Location:aws.String("s3://"+bucket+"/data/"),InputFormat:aws.String("org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat"),OutputFormat:aws.String("org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat"),SerdeInfo:&gt.SerDeInfo{SerializationLibrary:aws.String("org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe"),Parameters:map[string]string{"field.delim":","}}}}}); must(err)
 _, err = ac.CreateWorkGroup(ctx,&athena.CreateWorkGroupInput{Name:&workgroup,Configuration:&at.WorkGroupConfiguration{EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration:aws.Bool(true),BytesScannedCutoffPerQuery:aws.Int64(10485760),ResultConfiguration:&at.ResultConfiguration{OutputLocation:aws.String("s3://"+bucket+"/results/")}}}); must(err)
 catalog(); modeledErrors()
 input := &athena.StartQueryExecutionInput{QueryString:aws.String(sql),QueryExecutionContext:&at.QueryExecutionContext{Database:&database},WorkGroup:&workgroup,ClientRequestToken:aws.String(strings.Repeat("sdk205-212-",4)+database)}
 started, err := ac.StartQueryExecution(ctx,input); must(err); require(s(started.QueryExecutionId)!="","empty query ID")
 saved["query_id"]=s(started.QueryExecutionId); retain(); emit("query_started",map[string]any{"id":saved["query_id"],"sql":sql})
 retry, err := ac.StartQueryExecution(ctx,input); must(err); require(s(retry.QueryExecutionId)==saved["query_id"],"SDK query idempotency failed")
 deadline := time.Now().Add(300*time.Second)
 for {
  current, err := ac.GetQueryExecution(ctx,&athena.GetQueryExecutionInput{QueryExecutionId:started.QueryExecutionId}); must(err)
  require(current.QueryExecution!=nil && current.QueryExecution.Status!=nil,"missing decoded status")
  state := current.QueryExecution.Status.State

  if state==at.QueryExecutionStateSucceeded { break }

 }

}
func results() {
 id:=saved["query_id"]
 out, err := ac.GetQueryExecution(ctx,&athena.GetQueryExecutionInput{QueryExecutionId:&id}); must(err)
 q:=out.QueryExecution
 require(q!=nil && s(q.QueryExecutionId)==id && s(q.Query)==sql && s(q.WorkGroup)==workgroup && q.Status!=nil && q.Status.State==at.QueryExecutionStateSucceeded,"decoded execution mismatch")
 require(q.Status.SubmissionDateTime!=nil && q.Status.CompletionDateTime!=nil && !q.Status.CompletionDateTime.Before(*q.Status.SubmissionDateTime),"SDK timestamp decode mismatch")
 require(q.Statistics!=nil && aws.ToInt64(q.Statistics.DataScannedInBytes)==int64(len(data)),"native scanned bytes mismatch")
 require(q.ResultConfiguration!=nil && strings.HasPrefix(s(q.ResultConfiguration.OutputLocation),"s3://"+bucket+"/results/"),"result output location mismatch")
 want:=[][]string{{"label","total","precise","significant"},{"alpha","13","13.00","true"},{"beta","3","3.00","false"}}
 var rows [][]string; var token *string; var columns []at.ColumnInfo; pages:=0
 for {
  got, err := ac.GetQueryResults(ctx,&athena.GetQueryResultsInput{QueryExecutionId:&id,MaxResults:aws.Int32(2),NextToken:token}); must(err)

  columns=got.ResultSet.ResultSetMetadata.ColumnInfo

}

 defer func(){ if p:=recover(); p!=nil { emit("failure",fmt.Sprint(p)); os.Exit(1) } }()

}

def start(binary, native):
    global process, controller_log, controller
    args = [binary,'-listen',f'127.0.0.1:{PORT}','-public-endpoint',ENDPOINT,'-database',str(DB)]
    if native:
        args += ['-docker-host','unix:///var/run/docker.sock','-athena-runtime','-athena-image',TRINO,'-athena-hive-ddl-image',HIVE,'-compute-endpoint',f'http://host.docker.internal:{PORT}','-lambda-telemetry-directory','/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/bin']
    path = ROOT / f'controller-{len(REPORT["controllers"])+1}.log'
    controller = {'command':args,'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(binary).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'log_path':str(path)}
    REPORT['commands'].append(args)
    controller_log = path.open('wb')
    process = subprocess.Popen(args,env=ENV,stdout=controller_log,stderr=controller_log)
    deadline = time.monotonic()+60
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        assert process.poll() is None, f'controller exited {process.returncode}; {path.read_text()}'
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(ENDPOINT+'/_stackd/health',timeout=1) as response:
                if response.status == 200:
                    controller['ready_health_status']=200
                    return
        except OSError:
            pass
        time.sleep(0.1)
    raise TimeoutError('controller readiness deadline')

def stop():
    global process, controller_log, controller
    if process is None:
        return
    controller['already_exited']=process.poll() is not None
    controller['forced_kill']=False
    if process.poll() is None:
        process.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
    try:
        status=process.wait(timeout=35)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        controller['forced_kill']=True
        process.kill()
        status=process.wait(timeout=10)
    controller_log.close()
    controller['exit_status']=status
    controller['log']=Path(controller['log_path']).read_text()
    controller['race_report']='WARNING: DATA RACE' in controller['log']
    REPORT['controllers'].append(controller)
    process=None
    controller_log=None
    save()

def monitor(query_id):
    identity = 'aws\x00000000000000\x00us-east-1\x00'+query_id
    handle = 'stackd-athena-'+hashlib.sha256(identity.encode()).hexdigest()
    record = {'query_id':query_id,'handle':handle,'inspections':[],'logs':[],'info':[]}
    REPORT['native'][handle]=record
    deadline=time.monotonic()+330
    while not stop_monitors.is_set() and time.monotonic()<deadline:
        inspected=subprocess.run(['docker','--host','unix:///var/run/docker.sock','inspect',handle],env=ENV,text=True,capture_output=True)
        if inspected.returncode == 0:
            value=json.loads(inspected.stdout)[0]
            ports=value['NetworkSettings']['Ports'] or {}
            brief={'id':value['Id'],'name':value['Name'],'image':value['Image'],'labels':value['Config']['Labels'],'state':value['State'],'ports':ports}
            if not record['inspections'] or record['inspections'][-1] != brief:
                record['inspections'].append(brief)
            logged=subprocess.run(['docker','--host','unix:///var/run/docker.sock','logs',handle],env=ENV,text=True,capture_output=True)
            entry={'exit_status':logged.returncode,'stdout':logged.stdout,'stderr':logged.stderr}
            if not record['logs'] or record['logs'][-1]!=entry:
                record['logs']=[entry]
            for mapping in ports.values():
                for mapped in mapping or []:
                    try:
                        request=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:'+mapped['HostPort']+'/v1/info')
                        with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=0.5) as response:
                            info=json.load(response)
                        if not record['info'] or record['info'][-1]!=info:
                            record['info'].append(info)
                    except (OSError,ValueError):
                        pass
        elif record['inspections']:
            record['removed_during_execution']={'exit_status':inspected.returncode,'stderr':inspected.stderr}
            break
        stop_monitors.wait(0.4)

def sdk(mode):
    args=[str(ROOT/'sdk-proof'),mode,ENDPOINT,PREFIX,str(ROOT/'ids.json')]
    REPORT['commands'].append(args)
    path=ROOT/f'sdk-{mode}.jsonl'
    errpath=ROOT/f'sdk-{mode}.stderr'
    run={'mode':mode,'command':args,'events':[]}
    REPORT['sdk_runs'].append(run)
    with path.open('w') as out, errpath.open('w') as err:
        child=subprocess.Popen(args,env=ENV,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=err,text=True,bufsize=1)
        for line in child.stdout:
            out.write(line)
            out.flush()
            event=json.loads(line)
            run['events'].append(event)
            if event['kind']=='query_started':
                t=threading.Thread(target=monitor,args=(event['value']['id'],),daemon=True)
                t.start()
                threads.append(t)
        run['exit_status']=child.wait(timeout=10)
    run['stderr']=errpath.read_text()
    save()
    assert run['exit_status']==0, f'SDK {mode} failed: {run["events"][-1]}; {run["stderr"]}'

try:
    for image in [TRINO,HIVE]:
        result=command(['docker','image','inspect',image,'--format','{{.Id}} {{.Os}}/{{.Architecture}}'],timeout=30)
        REPORT.setdefault('installed_images',[]).append({'reference':image,'exit_status':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr})
        assert result.returncode==0
    start(OLD,False)
    sdk('seed')
    stop()
    schema('old_controller_closed_before_upgrade',205)
    assert not any(x.startswith(('glue_','athena_')) for x in REPORT['schemas'][-1]['relevant_tables'])
    start(NEW,True)
    schema('new_controller_opened_same_database',212)
    sdk('execute')
    stop()
    schema('new_controller_closed_after_query',212)
    start(NEW,True)
    sdk('reopen')
    sdk('cleanup')
    stop()
    schema('new_controller_closed_after_reopen_and_cleanup',212)
    REPORT['success']=True
except BaseException as exc:
    REPORT['success']=False
    REPORT['failure']={'type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc),'traceback':traceback.format_exc()}
finally:
    stop()
    stop_monitors.set()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join(timeout=10)
    ids_path=ROOT/'ids.json'
    if ids_path.exists():
        ids=json.loads(ids_path.read_text())
        query_id=ids.get('query_id')
        if query_id:
            identity='aws\x00000000000000\x00us-east-1\x00'+query_id
            handle='stackd-athena-'+hashlib.sha256(identity.encode()).hexdigest()
            listed=command(['docker','--host','unix:///var/run/docker.sock','ps','-a','--format','{{.Names}}'],timeout=30)
            assert listed.returncode==0, listed.stderr
            names=set(listed.stdout.splitlines())
            for name in (handle,handle+'-hiveddl'):
                exists=name in names
                evidence={'present_after_controller_exit':exists}
                if exists:
                    logs=command(['docker','--host','unix:///var/run/docker.sock','logs',name],timeout=30)
                    evidence['unexpected_survivor_logs']={'stdout':logs.stdout,'stderr':logs.stderr,'exit_status':logs.returncode}
                    removal=command(['docker','--host','unix:///var/run/docker.sock','rm','-f',name],timeout=30)
                    evidence['forced_owned_removal']={'stdout':removal.stdout,'stderr':removal.stderr,'exit_status':removal.returncode}
                    REPORT['success']=False
                REPORT['cleanup'][name]=evidence
    if REPORT.get('success'):
        assert len(REPORT['controllers'])==3 and all(c['exit_status']==0 and not c['forced_kill'] and not c['race_report'] for c in REPORT['controllers'])
        assert len({r['database_inode'] for r in REPORT['schemas']})==1
        assert REPORT['native'] and all(r['inspections'] for r in REPORT['native'].values())
        assert all(any(i['image']==TRINO.split('@')[1] and i['state']['Running'] for i in r['inspections']) for r in REPORT['native'].values())
    REPORT['limits']=['Local synthetic test/test account only; no native AWS parity claim.','One retained S3 CSV object and one metadata-only ECR repository; no ECR image push/pull.','One real Trino aggregate query with varchar/bigint/decimal/boolean result metadata and actual CSV bytes.','No Glue Spark/Python job, crawler, DDL parser execution, SQL cancellation, IAM deny, lake format or JDBC coverage; sibling owns broad workflow.','Old schema205 closed before upgrade; same database inode upgraded to212 and reopened with completed catalog/query/result state.','No tracked files or root module dependencies edited; no repository tests/build/lint/formatters run by this slice.']
    save()
    print(json.dumps({'success':REPORT.get('success'),'failure':REPORT.get('failure'),'report':str(ROOT/'report.json'),'controllers':[{'exit_status':c['exit_status'],'forced_kill':c['forced_kill']} for c in REPORT['controllers']],'schemas':[r['user_version'] for r in REPORT['schemas']],'native_handles':list(REPORT['native'])},indent=2))
    if not REPORT.get('success'):
        raise SystemExit(1)
